Source: @I_D_Network

🔲⭕️ What should Iran do? What are Iran's strategic priorities? Summary of the views of 140 experts and analysts in the Iran 2035 project. We believe that lacking strategic choices means surrendering a nation's future to geographic determinism, historical accidents, and foreign interventions. Today's Iran needs bold, coherent, and path-breaking choices that simultaneously ensure the country's development and security. This report answers two questions:◽️What path should Iran take for the next ten years?◽️What are Iran's strategic priorities?Note 1: Iran 2035 is not a government project; it was carried out with private sector support and personal funding.Note 2: This project certainly has shortcomings. Even if you are angry or dissatisfied with its results, turn great anger into great work and start another research effort that does not have the previous flaws. A chain of efforts, like a staircase, step by step brings us closer to the ultimate truth. There is no elevator.Note 3: One of the goals of Iran 2035 was to light the lamp of the future, even amid the crisis, the heat of war, and the siege that have limited our horizon to the coming week, month, and season. We hope we have succeeded.@Dr_Lashkarbolouki
